result.summary: The food delivery app page renders mostly correctly. Found a few minor layout and content truncation issues, plus an inconsistency in the favorite icon styling.

issues.description: Restaurant names and cards in the 'Fastest near you' horizontal list are cut off at the right edge (e.g. 'Trattoria Piccol...'), which may look like broken truncation.
issues.suggestion: Ensure partially visible cards clearly indicate horizontal scroll, or adjust card widths/padding so text truncates with an ellipsis intentionally.

issues.description: The favorite (heart) icons are styled inconsistently: the ramen card has a white circular background while the pizza card has a dark/transparent background, causing visual inconsistency.
issues.suggestion: Standardize the heart icon background and contrast treatment across all restaurant cards for a consistent look.

issues.description: The second 'Popular right now' pizza card is missing its title, rating, and delivery metadata, leaving the card visually incomplete compared to the ramen card above it.
issues.suggestion: Verify that restaurant details render for all cards, or confirm the content is intentionally scrolled out of view.
